metadata.title: OMEGA Unified Country General Data Registry

externalRefresh.policy: Initial snapshot aggregates local repository files only. Legacy values and source labels have not been independently revalidated; scheduled workflow can refresh reference sources.

dataQualityPolicy.nullMeans: unknown, unavailable, not imported, or not comparable; never zero
dataQualityPolicy.disciplineIndex: null until a defined comparable source or approved formula exists

notes: Not independently revalidated against official external statistical series in this snapshot.
No universal comparable country-level discipline index exists in the loaded sources.

sharedModelNotes.resourceEmptyLists: An empty local list does not prove absence of a resource.
